messages:
Lina: FYI ticket from Svenborg GmbH — they uploaded an EU VAT exemption cert but were still charged VAT on invoice INV-2026-1121. VIES shows the VAT ID as valid. Customer provided the upload ID and a screenshot of the invoice.
Devon: Can you drop the billing record link and a minimal repro? I can check the tax-service logs and DB row.
Lina: Link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-1121 (internal)
Lina: Repro steps I used in staging:
  1) create customer with vat_id: "DE123456789"
  2) upload evidence via POST /billing/customers/:id/evidence
  3) create invoice via POST /billing/invoices {"customer_id":..., "items":[...], "apply_reverse_charge": true}

The customer reports: reverse_charge not applied, VAT charged. They attached "svenborg_exemption.pdf" but also said their upload email bounced once.

BillingBot: Tax service health: OK (2026-06-02T09:14:02Z)
VIES check for DE123456789 => VALID

Devon: Quick check — I searched invoices table for INV-2026-1121 and see tax_applied = true and exemption_evidence_id = null. That suggests the evidence upload didn't attach to the invoice record. Possible race or webhook delivery failure.
Raj: Could also be normalization mismatch on vat_id. We previously had a bug where VAT IDs with leading country code lowercase or spaces didn’t match the canonicalized value during the invoice evaluation pass.

Devon: Running SQL to inspect stored vat_id and evidence links:
```
SELECT id, customer_id, vat_id_raw, vat_id_normalized, exemption_evidence_id, created_at
FROM customers
WHERE id = 3421;
```

Devon: Results => vat_id_raw = "DE 123456789"
vat_id_normalized = "de123456789"
exemption_evidence_id = NULL

Lina: Ah — customer uploaded evidence but our upload handler attaches to the normalized vat token. If the normalized value doesn't match the canonical used at invoice time, attachment can be orphaned.

Raj: I pushed a small fix to the normalization routine to normalize spaces and uppercase consistently. Also added a defensive join when attaching evidence so it matches on both raw and normalized forms. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/541

Devon: Manual remediation steps executed:
  - Attached evidence file svenborg_exemption.pdf to customer 3421 manually.
  - Updated invoice INV-2026-1121: tax_applied = false, tax_amount = 0.00, invoice reissued as INV-2026-1121-R1.
  - Credited the VAT line on original invoice.

Devon: Done — customer notified via email and we left an internal note.

Lina: Can you add a migration to fix existing customers with mismatched vat normalization? We should find records where exemption_evidence_id is NULL but an evidence file exists for raw vat.

Raj: Yep — adding a one-time migration script to reconcile evidence attachments and a monitoring alert for future failed-attach events. I'll schedule it in tonight's deploy window. Patch and migration pushed to staging.

BillingBot: Manual override applied by Devon at 2026-06-02T10:05:34Z. Invoice INV-2026-1121-R1 generated. Email sent to svenborg@contacts.svenborg.de

Lina: Closing loop: customer confirmed receipt and that net amount is correct. Marking this as resolved; tracking follow-up to ensure migration runs and alert added. :white_check_mark:
